title: Launch + Sunset Carousel Assets for Model Catalog Release Notes
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and deliver a compact set of onboarding and release-note screenshots and small-UI assets for the Model Catalog release that includes: new model launch tiles, sunset/deprecation banners, pricing ribbon variants, compact FTU (first-time-user) snapshot for quickstart, and localized/mobile variants. Assets should be export-ready for marketing/release notes and PRDs, meet accessibility contrast requirements, and include layer-separated source files for engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Six desktop screenshots exported at 1440px width + corresponding 375px mobile crops
Pricing ribbon (three tiers) overlayed on model tiles with approved copy and token cost per 1k
Deprecated model banner states (grace period / sunset date) with tooltip copy in English and FR
Consolidated Figma file with component variants and export slices, and design tokens synced to Tailwind variables
Hand-off checklist completed: Figma link, PNG/JPEG exports, layer names, redline spec, PRD link
